task.title: Find a person
task.shortdesc: Search your tree by a name, a place or an event, then open the person you want.

context.p: The search box is at the top of every screen. It searches the tree that is open.

step.cmd: Type a name, a place or an event in the box at the top.

stepresult.p: The results come in two lists side by side. The people come first. The events come next to them. A small badge on each person, such as Sources: 10, says how many sources back that person up.

step.cmd: Choose the card of the person you want.

stepresult.p: The page of that person opens. Their name shows in the chip that starts with .

result.p: Now , and in the menu all show that person.

postreq.p: To narrow the results, choose the button with the sliders next to . A list named opens. Tick , , or to add a filter. Tick to also find names that sound alike. Choose to start again.
